# [STORY] As an operator, I want free-tier IaC for Azure and AWS with Kubernetes manifests, so that the platform can run on real cloud infrastructure within a $0 budget

## User Story
**As an** operator
**I want** free-tier IaC for Azure and AWS with Kubernetes manifests
**So that** the platform can run on real cloud infrastructure within a $0 budget

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given `terraform apply` runs against Azure or AWS, when the cluster comes up, then the core services deploy via the Kustomize overlays and stay within free-tier limits (`terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform/azure validate`, `terraform -chdir=infrastructure/terraform/aws validate`, `kubectl kustomize infrastructure/kubernetes/overlays/{azure,aws}`; full apply/destroy history in #25, #26, #27)
- [x] Given `terraform destroy` runs, when the round-trip completes, then no billable resources are left running (manual: `terraform destroy` run against both clouds and confirmed clean — no VPCs, budgets, or instances left; see #26 and #27 Notes)

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 21

## Notes
Child Tasks #25, #26, #27 verified and merged to `develop`. #151 later widened Azure/AWS from the original core slice (api-gateway + movie-service + MongoDB + Redis) to the full local-parity service set (adds actor/user/ai-service, Postgres, Ollama) and rebranded the project's Terraform tags from `filmpire` to `lmdb` — #25, #26 and #27 carry the current values.
